description: This Java class 'TaskThreadedInitializationWrapper' wraps around an 'org.openmrs.scheduler.Task' to execute its 'initialize' method in a separate thread, allowing task initialization to occur asynchronously without blocking the main execution thread. It manages synchronization with locks and condition variables to ensure proper sequencing when executing the task.

classes.name: TaskThreadedInitializationWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class implementing the Task interface that executes task initialization asynchronously in a new thread and manages execution synchronization.

methods.name: TaskThreadedInitializationWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new wrapper around a given Task instance.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the wrapped task, waiting until initialization completes if necessary.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Begins asynchronous initialization of the wrapped task in a separate thread.

methods.name: getTaskDefinition
methods.description: Returns the task definition associated with the wrapped task.

methods.name: isExecuting
methods.description: Returns whether the wrapped task is currently executing.
